minimal_next_work_proposals.owner: Codex: static obligation audit; GPT/user: new proof scope if needed
minimal_next_work_proposals.input: Positive rational p/x, odd m, eta/rho/tau and input bit lengths; no new numerical input selected
minimal_next_work_proposals.output: One precision/API/whole-cost obligation specification and provenance index
minimal_next_work_proposals.go: Identify direct existing-lemma applications versus nontrivial missing proofs or implementation/physical acquisition gaps
minimal_next_work_proposals.stop: Routine closure completes specification, not a new theorem; return on new oracle/global dictionary/domain change
minimal_next_work_proposals.authorization: PROPOSAL_ONLY_NO_CONTRACT_OR_GRANT; later explicit task required; proof/implementation/science execution separately authorized

minimal_next_work_proposals.owner: Codex: question/source table; GPT/user: choice and scope of a new comparison proposition
minimal_next_work_proposals.input: Same finite P_m, m>=5, rational p/x, matched access/precision; P5Closed included for m=5
minimal_next_work_proposals.output: Three separated comparison questions (normalizer, certified N, actual cost); propose at most one follow-up proposition
minimal_next_work_proposals.go: Potential to change certified budget, cost feasibility region or an explicit limitation beyond a minor constant

minimal_next_work_proposals.authorization: PROPOSAL_ONLY_NO_CONTRACT_OR_GRANT; new proofs/asymptotics/counterexamples/science execution require separate authorization
